title: Technical Pathway and Transition Planning
summary: Compare future education and training routes connected to infrastructure interests.
objectives: Compare apprenticeship, college, technical school, and work-based learning options.
Connect technical interests to the Data Center Technical Operations pathway without claiming readiness.

vocab.def: A structured training pathway combining instruction and supervised work under its own rules.
A documented set of next learning or exploration steps.

sections.heading: More than one good route
sections.body: A student may continue through community college, technical school, university, apprenticeship, supervised work-based learning, or additional training. Requirements vary by provider and jurisdiction.

sections.heading: Choose informed next steps
sections.body: Use interests, access, safety requirements, cost, schedule, and support needs to ask good questions. A course completion is not a job or credential claim.

practice.prompt: Which question supports an informed transition plan?
practice.answer: What prerequisites, supervision, costs, and next learning steps does this provider require?

quiz.question: What does a reviewed technical capability represent?

lab.objective: Draft two open-ended questions for a future education or training provider.

reflectionPrompt: Which infrastructure system would you like to investigate more, and what would you need to learn next?

careerConnection.text: Data center technician is one possible informational connection; the next step may be education, training, supervised experience, or another route.
